caption: The drawing depicts a sculpted object with a base resembling a textured rock formation in shades of brown and gray. On top of the base, there is a large bird of prey, likely a hawk or falcon, rendered in shades of gray with darker patterns on its wings and detailed feather markings. This bird is perched with its wings spread and its beak slightly open, facing downward and to the left. To the left of the hawk, situated on a raised rocky ledge, is a smaller bird with grayish feathers, an open beak, and outstretched wings, appearing to interact with or face the larger bird. The base features carved details, including a small animal head peeking out from the lower right, colored in light brown and yellowish hues, and what appears to be a centipede in yellow-brown along the surface. The background is a solid, light beige color with no additional objects or scenery. The drawing includes careful shading and line work to emphasize three-dimensional form and textural detail. In the bottom right corner of the page, the name "C. W. Dawson" is written in smaller, reddish-brown letters.
title: Toy Bank: Eagle
